modules.title: Ownership and interests
modules.scope: Real and personal property, estates, concurrent ownership, encumbrances, legal descriptions, and land-use foundations.

modules.title: Contracts
modules.scope: Formation, enforceability, performance, breach, remedies, contingencies, purchase agreements, and leases.

modules.title: Agency and brokerage relationships
modules.scope: Creation and termination of relationships, duties, compensation, disclosure, and conflicts.

modules.title: Financing and calculations
modules.scope: Notes, mortgages or deeds of trust, loan markets, qualification, amortization, points, ratios, and settlement math.

modules.title: Valuation
modules.scope: Value principles, market analysis, sales comparison, cost, income, and basic investment calculations.

modules.title: Fair housing
modules.scope: Federal protected classes, prohibited conduct, advertising, disability accommodation, and equal professional service.

modules.title: Transfer and title
modules.scope: Deeds, recording, title evidence, involuntary transfer, closing, and settlement documents.

modules.title: Property management
modules.scope: Leasing, management agreements, operations, maintenance, risk, and tenant relations.

modules.title: Investment concepts
modules.scope: Cash flow, leverage, return measures, taxation orientation, and risk-return analysis.
